subjects.description: A real regulatory speed limit sign reading 'SPEED LIMIT 25' mounted on a galvanized metal post
subjects.appearance_details: White rectangular retroreflective sign with black lettering, weathered edges, slightly bent post, reflective under headlights
subjects.relationship: The legitimate authority sign that the vehicle should obey; contrasted with the fake projected sign
subjects.action: Standing at the roadside, illuminated by passing headlights
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger and brighter as the vehicle approaches, then slides out of frame to the right.

subjects.description: A bright projected image of a speed-limit sign showing a much higher number (85) cast onto the trunk of a roadside tree
subjects.appearance_details: Luminous white-and-black speed sign graphic distorted by rough bark texture, flickering, edges warping over the cylindrical trunk, faint light halo, no physical post
subjects.relationship: A deceptive projection meant to spoof the vehicle's perception system into speeding
subjects.location: right side, slightly beyond the real sign, on a tree trunk
subjects.orientation: Facing the camera vehicle, wrapped onto curved bark
subjects.pose: Projected flat image conforming to trunk contours
subjects.action: Flickering and shimmering, distorted by the bark texture
subjects.state_changes: Intensifies and destabilizes as headlights add competing light, remains clearly a projection.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a modern car whose interior dashboard and hood edge are faintly visible at the bottom of the frame
subjects.appearance_details: Dark dashboard silhouette, faint glow of instrument cluster, windshield reflections, headlight beams stretching forward onto the asphalt
subjects.relationship: The point-of-view vehicle whose driving-assist system misreads the projected sign
subjects.action: Driving down the two-lane road at full cruising speed, not slowing
subjects.state_changes: Maintains constant speed throughout, passing both signs without deceleration.

background_setting: A dark rural-to-town transition on a two-lane asphalt road at night. The vehicle is entering the outskirts of a small town, with faint distant streetlights, dim porch lights, and low silhouettes of buildings ahead. Roadside vegetation, utility poles, and a large tree line the right shoulder. Headlights carve bright cones onto the road, revealing lane markings, a broken center line, and reflective sign faces. The sky is a deep near-black with no moonlight, and the surroundings fall off into darkness beyond the beams.

lighting.shadows: Long dark shadows cast behind the sign post and tree, deep black voids off-road
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast pools of bright light against near-total darkness, retroreflective glare on the real sign and unnatural glow on the projected sign

aesthetics.patterns: Repeating road lane dashes and roadside poles receding into darkness

context: Illustrative demonstration of an adversarial sign-spoofing attack on autonomous vehicle perception

The vehicle passes the real 25 sign and reveals the projected higher-number sign flickering on the tree trunk just beyond it. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues at full cruising speed past both signs without slowing, the projected sign distorting over the bark as it passes into the town. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a dark two-lane road with headlights cutting into the night as the town approaches. By 0:01 the real SPEED LIMIT 25 sign glows on a post to the right, clearly legible. At 0:02 the vehicle passes the real sign and a bright, flickering projected speed-limit sign showing 85 appears cast onto a roadside tree trunk, its numbers warping over the bark. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle continues at its full cruising speed past both signs without slowing, the fake projection distorting as it slips past, and the car rolls on into the dimly lit town. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
